dimensions.description: Selects Skill Writing for creating or revising Agent Skills and respects its specialized exclusions and canonical invocation.

evals.name: create-agent-skill
evals.prompt: Create an Agent Skill for recurring deployment triage, including SKILL.md and evaluation cases.
evals.expected_output: Skill Writing activates for creating an Agent Skill.
expectations: The host records Skill Writing and its canonical dependency closure.

evals.name: revise-agent-skill
evals.prompt: Revise this existing Agent Skill so its trigger boundaries and completion criteria are observable.
evals.expected_output: Skill Writing activates for revising an Agent Skill.
expectations: The host records Skill Writing and its canonical dependency closure.

evals.name: general-agent-artifact-exclusion
evals.prompt: Write an operating procedure for an automation agent; this is not an Agent Skill package.
evals.expected_output: Skill Writing stays inactive because Agent Writing owns general agent-facing artifacts.
expectations: The host does not record Skill Writing activation.

evals.name: fresh-context-handoff-exclusion
evals.prompt: Prepare a handoff that lets a fresh agent context continue this work.
evals.expected_output: Skill Writing stays inactive because Take It Offline owns fresh-context handoffs.
expectations: The host does not record Skill Writing activation.

evals.name: skill-installation-exclusion
evals.prompt: Install the existing incident-investigation Skill into my user Skill directory.
evals.expected_output: Skill Writing stays inactive because installation is not Skill authoring.
expectations: The host does not record Skill Writing activation.

evals.name: skill-publication-and-marketplace-exclusion
evals.prompt: Publish the existing Skill to our marketplace without changing its behavior or representation.
evals.expected_output: Skill Writing stays inactive because publication and marketplace operations are separate requests.
expectations: The host does not record Skill Writing activation.

evals.name: canonical-direct-invocation
evals.prompt:
/skill-writing

Create a small Agent Skill from this decided recurring behavior.
evals.expected_output: Direct canonical invocation selects Skill Writing and its dependency closure.
expectations: The host records invocation of Skill Writing by its canonical name.
